account.title: Account
account.shortcutMeta: Check a book right in the store
account.passwordNote: The shortcut and assistants will be disconnected and need to be connected again. This device stays signed in.
iphoneSteps: Create a token and copy it.
Install the shortcut and paste the token when it asks.
In a store, tap Share and choose Book Shelf.
account.androidText: Add Book Shelf to the home screen from the browser menu. It shows up in the Share menu, no token needed.
account.mcpLead: Connect Book Shelf to Claude, ChatGPT or Gemini, and the assistant will answer from your shelf: what you have read, what you wanted to read, how much you listened to this year.

claudeSteps.title: Open the connector settings
claudeSteps.text: On claude.ai or in the Claude desktop app: Settings → Connectors.

claudeSteps.title: Add a custom connector
claudeSteps.text: Click "Add custom connector", name it Book Shelf and paste the URL above.

claudeSteps.title: Sign in and allow access
claudeSteps.text: Claude opens a Book Shelf page. Sign in if needed and click "Allow".

claudeSteps.title: Ask about your books
claudeSteps.text: The connector also shows up in the Claude mobile app. Turn it on in a chat.

chatgptSteps.title: Open plugins
chatgptSteps.text: In ChatGPT on the web, open Plugins in the sidebar. If the Add menu has no Add custom MCP server item, turn on Developer mode in Settings → Security and login.

chatgptSteps.title: Add an MCP server
chatgptSteps.text: Click Add → Add custom MCP server, name it Book Shelf, paste the URL above and choose OAuth sign in.

chatgptSteps.title: Sign in and allow access
chatgptSteps.text: A Book Shelf page opens. Sign in if needed and click "Allow".

chatgptSteps.title: Turn it on in a chat
chatgptSteps.text: Choose Book Shelf in the chat's list of tools.

account.geminiFor: For Gemini Enterprise and Gemini Business.

geminiSteps.title: Add a custom MCP server
geminiSteps.text: In Gemini: Connectors → Custom MCP server. Paste the URL above, the authorization and token URLs, the Client ID and the secret.

geminiSteps.title: Allow access
geminiSteps.text: Gemini opens a Book Shelf page, click "Allow".

footer.tagline: Book Shelf · one shelf for Litres and Kindle

landing.title: Book Shelf: everything you have read and listened to, on one shelf
landing.h1: Everything you have read and listened to, on one shelf
landing.lead: Audiobooks from Litres and books from Kindle go onto the shelves by themselves. And before you buy, "Share" tells you whether you have read the book already.

steps.title: Sign in to Litres
steps.text: Sign in on the Litres site any way you like, and your audiobooks go onto the shelves. The password never reaches us.

steps.title: Sync Kindle
steps.text: Sign in to Amazon, and books, documents and audiobooks go onto the shelves. What you have read is marked by itself.

steps.title: Add the rest
steps.text: A paper book or a gift can be written in by hand. A book bought in two stores becomes one.

landing.readLead: In a store, tap "Share" and pick Book Shelf. The answer comes in one line, before you finish reading the blurb.
landing.yearLead: In December, see how much you have read and listened to. Twelve stacks, one per month, and your favorite authors.
landing.assistantLead: Connect Book Shelf to Claude, and it answers from your shelf: what you have read, what you wanted to read, how much you listened to this year.
chat: Yes, you listened to "Солярис" by Станислав Лем in March 2024, an audiobook from Litres.
Add Klara and the Sun to Want
Done, the book is on the Want shelf.

own.title: The password is not stored
own.text: You sign in to Litres and Amazon on their own pages, in a browser on our server. The password never reaches us, and the session is deleted after the sync.

own.title: Delete with one button
own.text: In the account you can erase everything at once: books, notes, assistant connections.

questions.q: Do I need a Litres subscription or Kindle Unlimited?
questions.a: No. Book Shelf collects the books you bought. Books from subscriptions do not get onto the shelf yet.

questions.q: How do books from Kindle get in?
questions.a: Sign in to Amazon in the Book Shelf window: books, documents and audiobooks go onto the shelves by themselves. New purchases can be added through "Share".
Nothing. Book Shelf is an open project.
Book Shelf opens in the browser and installs on the phone home screen like an app. The "Share" shortcut works on iPhone and Android.
